title: UAAP: ‘It’s an identity problem,’ says Cortez as La Salle’s struggles pile up
summary: De La Salle University’s title defense is off to a shaky start, to say the least, and Jacob Cortez said this could be attributed to the Green Archers still trying to establish their character.
